## Controller 1.0.46 (53)
- **Native composer plan chip morph:** The composer's task plan chip now shows a compact `Step N/M` pill (`Plan complete` when finished) that morphs smoothly into a `Plan · Step N/M` card over all steps using Liquid Glass matched-geometry transitions across macOS and iOS while preserving keyboard focus (`Space` and `Return`). - **ControllerMobile sidebar & foldable polish:** Placed the sidebar search trigger beside `Settled` and `New Chat` and kept the split view clear of the iPhone Duo fold. - **Connect & host hardening:** Hardened per-host model catalogs, Windows host/tunnel resilience, and remote RPC dispatch for mobile companions.

## Controller 1.0.46 (52)
- Allow Android clients to authenticate with Controller Connect hosts. Install this update before connecting from the new Android app. - Prepare Connect authentication for Windows clients. - Give Claude SDK startup and control requests up to ten minutes on slower connections.
On your Mac, sign in under Settings → Connect and enable “Make this Mac reachable from your other devices.” Sign in to the same Controller account on Android.

- Adds a standalone Home button next to Back and Forward in the titlebar when viewing Settings, Usage, or Pull Requests. - Automatically connects all configured and newly discovered harnesses at launch so their live model lists and status are ready immediately. - Expires the trackpad Forward page-swipe gesture 30 seconds after the last Back or Forward step so later leftward swipes on a conversation do not reopen an earlier page. - Fixes Pull Requests flickering and reloading repeatedly on first launch. - Fixes unsettled threads occasionally appearing as blank rows in the sidebar after being settled via a swipe gesture. - Hides transcript and composer scroll bars until scrolled when a mouse or legacy scroll bar setting is active.
